description: This is a Java source file defining the JournalEntriesImportHandler class, which implements import handling for journal entries in a bulk import process within the Apache Fineract project. It reads journal entry data from an Excel workbook, processes each entry, and submits create commands for each journal entry.

classes.name: JournalEntriesImportHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles importing journal entries from an Excel file into the Fineract system.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Orchestrates the reading of journal entries from the workbook and initiates their import.

methods.name: readExcelFile
methods.description: Parses the specified Excel sheet to extract journal entry data and organize it into JournalEntryData objects.

methods.name: readAddJournalEntries
methods.description: Reads a row from the Excel sheet to create a JournalEntryData object representing a single journal entry.

methods.name: importEntity
methods.description: Sends the list of journal entries to the backend for creation and updates success/error counts, updating the sheet accordingly.
